content_of_post_to_comment: My Libertarian Regret Many moons ago I advocated for the legalization of drugs and gambling. Not because I think either is a good idea, but because I didn’t want the State to throw people in jail when they chose to harm themselves. Oh, how I underestimated the number of people willing to harm themselves and the collateral damage that would follow.
comment: The harder question may be whether liberty requires a culture capable of handling freedom. Legalization debates often focus on state power, but less on the institutions and norms that absorb the consequences of personal choices.
